svg.title: Chain of custody ledger
svg.desc: 1 sealed entries. Head bf1c2c96a6af88fe5fe70e31b18942a24c5d72368385df3ec3dff661bf1c0115. Verify with python verify.py.
svg.text: Each day of public activity is hashed into the entry that follows it. Alter one, and every later hash breaks.
